detail.longDescription: https://github.com/avadaniels-labs/pptx-render-bench I'm building Folio, a Rust PPTX renderer, and wanted to know how close any renderer gets to real PowerPoint. So I scored ~1,900 slides against PowerPoint exports. Folio 0.944, ONLYOFFICE 0.912, LibreOffice 0.888, POI 0.837 (SSIM, PPTArena). Bias warning: it's mine, and ONLYOFFICE still wins 216 slides. The benchmark is open, so submissions and criticism are welcome.
